# Soheil Aghayani

> Soheil Aghayani is an environmental engineer, researcher, and software builder working across solid waste systems, waste valorization, life-cycle thinking, biofuel research, and useful digital tools.

## Research

- Master's thesis: biodiesel production from waste cooking oil using a catalyst synthesized from waste seashells.
- Public thesis visuals: https://agseyl.ir/assets/thesis-infographic.jpg, https://agseyl.ir/assets/thesis-ftir-peaks.png, and https://agseyl.ir/assets/thesis-ftir-library-search.png
- Research directions: waste systems, life-cycle assessment, biomass resources, landfill-gas modelling, resource recovery, and cleaner process design.
- Education: MSc Environmental Engineering at the University of Tehran and BSc Civil Engineering at Shahed University.

- Use the live portfolio for the current bilingual presentation and progressive disclosure of details.
